items.description:
UFO Savannah Mall is a United Furniture Outlets showroom trading from Shop G33 inside Savannah Mall in Fauna Park. The showroom's own branch page describes a selection built around contemporary lounge suites and practical bedroom solutions, with a team on hand in-store to help shoppers put together a look for a living room, bedroom or smaller corner of the home.

As part of the national UFO chain, the Fauna Park showroom carries the same household focus the brand is known for elsewhere, from couches and coffee tables to recliners and plasma stands, rather than a single decor style. It is a practical stop for households across Fauna Park and the wider Polokwane area who want to see furniture in person before buying, with trading hours posted on the storefront running into the early evening on weekdays and shorter hours over the weekend.

OK Furniture's Mankweng branch trades from Shop 51 in Paledi Mall, in the Turfloop Township area of Mankweng, as part of the retailer's nationwide furniture, appliance and electronics network. The store's own branch page positions it as a destination for affordable, quality furniture and appliances, covering everything from lounge and bedroom suites to kitchen appliances and the latest cellular and electronic products.

Shoppers can apply for store credit in branch, and the Mankweng store carries the same mid-income household focus as other OK Furniture outlets, stocking lounge, bedroom and outdoor furniture alongside branded appliances. It serves households across Mankweng, Turfloop and the surrounding communities who want to furnish or upgrade a home without travelling into central Polokwane, with the Paledi Mall location putting the store within easy reach of the local area.

Old Khaki trades from Shop U81a in Mall of the North, bringing the South African casual-lifestyle label's clothing, footwear and accessories to Bendor. The brand's relaxed, durable pieces are built for everyday wear as well as outdoor-ready outings, and the Mall of the North store carries the same range of men's and women's basics, layers and accessories found at Old Khaki stores elsewhere in the country.

The shop is listed in the centre's own store directory alongside the other national fashion names trading from Mall of the North, confirming its place in the mall's fashion line-up. It serves men and women across Bendor and the wider Polokwane area who want casual, hardwearing clothing rather than formal wear, and keeps the same hours as the rest of the centre: open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays.

Polokwane Place, listed online as Polokwane Place-Uhuru Manor, is a guest house on Burger Street in Hospital Park offering family rooms with air conditioning, private bathrooms and views over the garden or pool. Guest-review data collected on a major accommodation booking platform shows 213 reviews and a 7.9 out of 10 rating for the property, a solid base of feedback for a guest house of this size in Polokwane.

The guest house suits families and other short-stay visitors looking for a home-like base with air-conditioned comfort, rather than a large hotel. It is located at 65 Burger Street in Hospital Park, within easy reach of Polokwane's central business area, and is best suited to travellers planning a short stay in the city.

items.description:
Sentech is South Africa's state-owned broadcasting signal distributor, providing terrestrial and satellite infrastructure that carries public, community and commercial radio and television signals across the country. Its corporate site describes a broader push into broadband, managed infrastructure and satellite business units alongside its traditional broadcast-signal role, run through a national network of facilities that includes data centres and transmission towers.

Local business directories place a Sentech office in Eduan Park, Polokwane, listing it under signal and warning-related business categories, which reflects the technical, infrastructure-based nature of the site rather than a public-facing storefront. The Eduan Park office forms part of Sentech's regional footprint supporting broadcasters and related technical services in Limpopo, rather than a retail or walk-in service point.

Stewarts & Lloyds Polokwane trades from Kobalt Street in Nirvana as the group's Steel & Hardware branch, stocking steel and tube products, pipes and fittings, valves, pumps, irrigation and fencing supplies alongside general hardware. The branch sits within a national network that, according to the Independent Steel Forum's member directory, spans more than 38 branches across South Africa and into Namibia, built on more than a century in the steel-supply trade.

The Polokwane footprint grew in 2022 when the company opened a second, dedicated Fluid Control branch in Superbia alongside the existing Nirvana hardware branch, splitting fluid-handling products such as pumps and irrigation equipment from the core steel and hardware range. The Nirvana branch serves builders, contractors, farmers and other customers across Polokwane needing steel, piping and general hardware supplies.

Studio 88 trades from Shop U36 in Mall of the North, bringing South Africa's largest branded footwear and clothing retailer to Bendor. The store is an official reseller of international sneaker and sportswear brands, carrying footwear and apparel from names such as Nike, adidas and Puma alongside its own in-house ranges, and is listed in the centre's own store directory among the mall's fashion and footwear tenants.

It serves sneaker and sportswear shoppers across Bendor and greater Polokwane looking for current releases and everyday athletic wear rather than a single specialist brand. The store follows Mall of the North's standard trading hours, open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays, making it an easy stop alongside the rest of a shopping trip at the centre.

Tax Saviour (Pty) Ltd is an accounting, tax and advisory firm in Polokwane, offering accounting, taxation and consulting services. Its services include corporate and personal taxation, accounting and bookkeeping, and advisory work aimed at improving the financial outlook and performance of clients. The firm was established in 2017 and offers tailor-made services to clients across the country.

The company describes its service as a single point of contact, backed by a team of experienced and diverse professionals. Its website highlights excellence, integrity, accountability, professionalism and transparency. Based in Polokwane in Limpopo, the company says it is looking to grow into other provinces.

AesthetiCo fuses the art and science of beauty for face, body and wellness treatments in Polokwane. Its services include botox, dermal fillers, chemical peels, vampire facials and platelet-rich plasma treatments. Each treatment programme is shaped around the client's age, personal budget and individual body concerns, with the aim of reaching short- and long-term goals as economically as possible.

The practice works in collaboration with The Aesthetic Clinic, which has sites in Waterkloof and Secunda, and its team includes a qualified medical aesthetic therapist. Its approach is holistic, addressing the client's concerns as a whole. The practice is located at 50b Compensatie Street in Polokwane, in the Hospital Park area.

Auto Electrical & Aircon Specialist is a vehicle electrical workshop on Hoof Street in Superbia, handling wiring, electrical fault-finding and repairs alongside air-conditioning installation and servicing for cars and light vehicles. The business is a member of the Motor Industry Workshop Association, a trade body whose member workshops are expected to employ qualified technicians and follow recognised repair standards.

Its Facebook page describes the team as the area's pit crew for auto electrical and aircon work, turning tricky diagnostic problems into straightforward fixes for everyday motorists. The workshop serves vehicle owners across Superbia and the wider Polokwane area who need an electrical fault diagnosed and fixed, or an aircon system repaired rather than replaced outright, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and on Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00.

Baby City's Mall of the North branch, in Shop L11, stocks the retailer's usual range of prams, car seats, cots, nursery furniture, baby clothing and toiletries for parents and parents-to-be. The chain's own branch page for this store confirms Click and Collect ordering, letting customers reserve stock online and collect it in person at the Bendor store rather than waiting for home delivery.

Shoppers can also join the group's Better Rewards programme in-store for ongoing discounts across baby-care brands, and build gift registries ahead of a baby shower or arrival. The Mall of the North branch serves parents and families across Bendor and the wider Polokwane area looking for everyday baby essentials as well as bigger-ticket nursery items in one visit.

Bargain Books at Savannah Mall is the Limpopo branch of South Africa's discount bookstore chain, trading from Shop 6 in the mall's retail line-up in Fauna Park. The business is listed in local directories under books and book-seller categories, confirming its place among Savannah Mall's book and gift tenants.

As part of the wider Bargain Books network, the Fauna Park store carries the chain's usual mix of bestsellers, children's titles and value-priced fiction, and periodically runs its own clearance and promotional sales rather than relying only on cover-price stock. It serves readers and book buyers across Fauna Park and greater Polokwane looking for new titles at reduced prices, rather than shoppers seeking a specific rare or out-of-print book.

items.description:
Blesbok Inn is a bed-and-breakfast on Blesbok Avenue in Fauna Park, about two kilometres from Polokwane's city centre, offering free Wi-Fi and breakfast alongside its rooms. Its listing on an accommodation booking platform shows a Standard King/Twin Room that sleeps up to six guests, with an en-suite bathroom, king-size bed, TV, bar fridge and microwave, and confirms the property welcomes children of all ages.

Check-in runs from 14:00 to 19:00 and check-out is by 10:00, with free secure parking provided for guests who drive. The guest house suits families and other short-stay visitors looking for a self-contained, home-style base close to Polokwane rather than a large hotel, with straightforward room facilities covering everyday needs.

items.description:
Freedom of Movement trades from Shop U96 in Mall of the North, bringing the Stellenbosch-founded lifestyle label's clothing, footwear and leather goods to Bendor. The brand, founded in 2013, is known for pairing casual apparel with accessories such as bags, sneakers and vellies, and its Mall of the North store is listed on the brand's own site as a dedicated branch alongside the mall's other fashion tenants.

It serves shoppers across Bendor and the wider Polokwane area looking for South African-designed casual wear and leather accessories rather than imported fast fashion. The store follows the centre's standard trading hours, open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 17:00 over weekends and public holidays, making it easy to combine with the rest of a visit to Mall of the North.

Shop 6 in Ivy Park Centre on Campbell Street is home to Galito's Ivy Park, part of the national flame-grilled chicken chain known for its peri-peri marinades. Diners can choose a flavour running from BBQ and Lemon & Herb through to Mild, Hot and Extra Hot peri-peri, paired with fresh-cut chips and a range of sides, with the branch's own page promising bold flame-grilled taste on every order.

The Mypark X9 branch handles dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders, serving individuals, families and groups in Ivy Park and the surrounding suburbs who want a quick flame-grilled meal without cooking at home. It trades seven days a week from 09:00 to 21:00, giving customers a consistent window for lunch, dinner or a late takeaway order throughout the week.

items.description:
The Grace Terraces Guest House is an accommodation property on Kremetart Street in Flora Park, with its own website confirming the address and contact details for direct bookings. A listing on an international hotel-booking site describes a guest house with a garden setting, free Wi-Fi and free private parking for guests arriving by car.

The property offers family rooms with a terrace and a private bathroom in each unit, giving groups and relatives travelling together more space than a single hotel room. It serves short-stay visitors to Polokwane looking for a quieter, garden-set base in Flora Park rather than a large hotel, within reach of the city's shopping centres and other attractions.

Image Travel and Tours is a travel agency in Polokwane, Limpopo, established in 2011. It arranges international tours, national and Limpopo tour packages, local and international safari packages, and local and international hunting packages. Blue Train trips and cruises are also on offer.

Weekend-away packages include trips to Kruger National Park, Magoebaskloof and the Maphungubwe heritage sites, with accommodation and game drives included in some of them. Sports packages are offered alongside the tour and safari options. The website is available in English and Spanish, and visitors can contact the agency or book online.

The agency is based in Polokwane Central and suits travellers who want a planned trip, from a weekend away in Limpopo to an overseas safari.

items.description:
Madulo Guest House offers overnight accommodation in Flora Park, Polokwane, in rooms described as unique, luxurious and spacious, with high-quality posturepedic mattresses and energy-saving features. Freshly made breakfasts and dinners are served in a homely dining area that opens onto a warm, tranquil garden, and guests can relax in the private garden as well.

The guest house has a conference facility suited to intimate meetings, private functions or quiet business work. The website also includes a beauty salon, Pop of Colour, which offers express services such as nail gel polish, make-up and massages, and stocks premium Brazilian and Peruvian hair extensions. Guests describe the place as homely, with a nice atmosphere.

Markham's Seshego Circle store brings the menswear retailer's smart and casual clothing, footwear and accessories to Ditlou Street in Seshego. The chain anchors its denim range around its own Relay Jeans label, stocked alongside international names such as G-Star and Levi's, and the Seshego Circle branch is listed in local store directories as one of Markham's Limpopo outlets.

As part of The Foschini Group's menswear portfolio, the store draws on a national buying network while serving a local customer base of men across Seshego and the surrounding townships who want both everyday basics and going-out pieces in one place. The branch gives Seshego shoppers a menswear option without needing to travel into central Polokwane for current denim and footwear ranges.

MTN's Savannah Mall store, in Shop 64 of the mall's Electronics & Cellular section, sells SIM cards, contracts, devices and accessories for customers in Fauna Park and the surrounding suburbs. The network operator's own store locator lists the branch among its service points offering in-store device support, including repairs, alongside new connections and upgrades.

The Savannah Mall location sits among several other cellular and electronics retailers in the centre, giving customers a place to compare devices and plans in person rather than only online. It serves both new customers signing up for contracts or prepaid SIMs and existing MTN customers who need account queries, upgrades or device repairs handled face to face.

Paint Pot Polokwane has been operating since 2005 and has a floor space of 1,850 square metres. The store stocks the full Prominent Paints decorative range and two premium automotive paint brands, along with industrial paint, woodcare products, specialised coatings and a farming range. Its accessories include paint rollers and sandpaper.

The store's colour specialists can match almost any shade, and its Arts and Crafts division runs regular classes for people of all ages. The Paint Pot Group has been selling Prominent paints for 25 years, and it also has stores in Tzaneen, Hoedspruit, Giyani and Phalaborwa. The Polokwane store is in Superbia.

Pest Control Hygiene and Cleaning, based at Flora Park Shopping Centre, has offered pest control and cleaning services in Polokwane for 25 years. Its listed service range covers termite proofing and general pest control alongside hygiene-equipment supply, janitorial products and consumables, positioning it as a combined pest-control and hygiene-supplies business rather than a pest-only operator.

On the cleaning side, the business covers ablution cleaning, ceiling cleaning, carpet cleaning and general contract and commercial cleaning, in addition to house cleaning for residential clients. It serves commercial, industrial and domestic customers across Flora Park and wider Polokwane who want pest treatment and ongoing hygiene or cleaning support from a single, long-established local supplier rather than separate specialists for each job.

Polo Guest House is a garden guesthouse in Polokwane with 11 en-suite rooms, a pool, breakfast, secure parking and conference space for 34 people. The business is privately owned and run, and its rooms include air conditioning, satellite TV, tea and coffee facilities, twin beds, a kitchenette and a private patio.

The guesthouse is an Afristay award winner, and guests can book through NightsBridge. It describes itself as a sanctuary garden in the heart of the city, with comfortable rooms and a welcome where guests are remembered. It is a good base for business trips, conferences or a slow weekend away, and the property sits in Hospital Park.

items.description:
Savannah Guest House, on Marshall Street in Flora Park, offers air-conditioned rooms each with a private bathroom, television and tea and coffee facilities. Outside, guests have access to a swimming pool, garden and a braai and fireplace area for evenings, with on-site parking provided for those arriving by car.

The property is set up as a straightforward guest house rather than a full-service hotel, giving visitors private rooms with hotel-style comforts in a quieter, residential part of Flora Park. It suits short-stay travellers, couples and small groups visiting Polokwane who want outdoor space to relax in alongside their room, rather than a conference venue or large events property.

Sea Water Boutique Lodge, on a residential plot in Mankweng, takes its name from a respected figure in the local community, with the lodge's concept built around that namesake's story of warmth, humility and comfort. Founded in 2019 and launched in December 2021, the property positions itself among Mankweng's more design-led accommodation options, with each room's interior planned and furnished individually rather than following a single standard layout.

The lodge offers conferencing facilities and fine dining alongside its accommodation, and independent travel-review listings confirm spa treatments are also available on site, alongside free Wi-Fi and secure parking. It serves accommodation guests, conference and event groups, and visitors looking for a boutique hospitality and wellness experience in Mankweng rather than a standard hotel stay.

Splash JumpZone Polokwane is a family water park in Dalmada, Polokwane, with swimming pools, super tubes and a JumpZone trampoline park. The park is a safe and exciting environment for all ages, and its picnic and braai spots are set in scenic outdoor areas.

Entrance is R120 per person for adults and children aged 13 and over, R100 for children aged 3 to 12, and R60 for pensioners. The venue can also be booked for birthday parties, family outings and other events, with options ranging from R200 to R400. The park suits families looking for a full day of fun, from pools and slides to bounce and braai time.

items.description:
Point S Tyres Polokwane, listed as Turbo Tyres, fits tyres for trucks, buses, tractors, SUVs and passenger vehicles. Its services include wheel alignment, wheel balancing, suspension diagnostics, puncture repairs, batteries, shock absorbers, suspension parts and mag wheels.

The business supplies a wide range of tyre brands and carries its own private-label range, which its website says is manufactured in Europe for South African roads and climate. Further services include lubrication, emergency tyre help, brakes, engine services, safety checks, aircon services, a carwash, a motorcycle workshop and fleet services. Customers can request a quotation through the website or start a WhatsApp chat, and the branch is in Polokwane Central.

Vertex Boreholes is a professional borehole drilling company with its head office in Polokwane. It drills and installs domestic, commercial and industrial boreholes, and supplies borehole pumps, tanks, tank stands, manhole covers, trenching and PVC or steel casing. The team has extensive experience in the industry, including specialised Odex drilling.

Packages can be tailored to each client, from electric systems to off-grid solutions that give full control over the water supply. The company services Polokwane and surrounding areas including Seshego, Mankweng, Lebowakgomo, Chuenespoort, Burgersfort and Groblersdal, among others. Its website also has an online shop for borehole drilling, electrical pumps and other borehole needs.

items.description:
Ambiance Restaurant is a restaurant and conference venue in Polokwane, known for its old-world charm and garden tables under the shade of jacaranda trees. It serves breakfast, a quick business lunch and evening meals, with a menu that includes starters, toasted sandwiches, burgers, pastas, soups, lunch dishes, desserts, hot and cold drinks and a wine list.

Guests can call and collect an order or order delivery within a four to five kilometre radius, with delivery timed from orders placed before 10:00, 12:00 or 15:00. The restaurant also offers conference facilities, and its staff aim to make every visit memorable. It is a welcoming choice for a leisurely breakfast, a business lunch or an evening under the stars.

items.description:
Bakone Malapa Northern Sotho Open-Air Museum is a living museum near Polokwane, built as a reconstructed village in the style the northern Sotho used about 250 years ago. It shows the daily life of the Bakone, a highly sophisticated subgroup of the northern Sotho, and is one of two similar open-air museums in Limpopo.

Guides demonstrate how fire is made, how maize is ground and how beer is brewed, with two homesteads, or lapas, that display and explain these traditions. Handcraft demonstrations include pottery, basketry and beadwork, and most of the locally made crafts are sold at the village craft shop. The guides are described as excellent storytellers who bring the village's architecture and culture to life.

Beauty of the Bride specialises in wedding dresses, with a wide selection from local and international designers at prices the business describes as suitable. Brides can choose to buy or hire their wedding dress, and the website shows standard gowns and new gowns to browse.

The business has been operating for more than nine years and says that finding the right dress is the part of the wedding most brides care about most. Its aim is to help brides look their best on the day and to find an affordable dress that feels like a fairy-tale choice. Each gown on the website has an enquiry option, and visitors can book an appointment online.

Appointments are available on weekdays from 09:00 to 17:00 and on Saturdays from 09:00 to 15:00, with public-holiday visits by appointment only. The shop is based in Polokwane Central.

Biddulphs International's Polokwane operation is a furniture-removals and relocation business run through the group's branch network, with the company's own branch page confirming that its Polokwane service area covers Polokwane, Tzaneen, Mokopane, Louis Trichardt and Lephalale across Limpopo. Rather than running as a fully standalone branch, the Polokwane operation is serviced from the company's Pretoria branch, reflecting how the national mover organises its regional coverage.

Customers can expect help with household and business moves, including packing assistance for a full home or office relocation, drawing on the group's century-long history in the removals trade. It serves residential customers, families and organisations relocating within Polokwane and the wider Limpopo region, or further afield through the company's broader national and international network.

BUCO Ga Thoka is a hardware and building-materials store on the R71 in Ga Thoka, serving the Mankweng area with building supplies, tools and related trade products since opening in November 2021. The branch is listed on the BUCO network's own store locator, run through parent group The Building Company, confirming its place among the chain's hardware outlets supplying contractors and DIY customers across the region.

The store also distributes JoJo water-storage and pump products locally, giving customers access to tanks, water filters and pump solutions alongside everyday building materials. It serves builders, tradespeople and homeowners in Ga Thoka, Mankweng and the surrounding communities looking for a single local hardware stop for construction and water-storage needs.

Cashbuild Madiba Park trades at the corner of Nelson Mandela Drive and Madiba Park Crossing in Seshego, part of the Cashbuild hardware and building-materials chain. The branch's own store page lists a broad in-stock range covering cement, timber, hardware, plumbing, electrical fittings, roofing, paint and garden supplies, with staff on hand to give advice to contractors, DIY shoppers and homeowners alike.

Customers can request online quotes ahead of a visit, and the store offers free local delivery on qualifying orders alongside standard over-the-counter purchases. It serves builders and tradespeople working on projects around Seshego, as well as homeowners tackling smaller DIY jobs, giving the area a single stop for everyday building-material needs without travelling further into Polokwane.

items.description:
The jewellery business offers platinum, diamond, white gold, yellow gold, palladium, silver and gemstone jewellery, as well as watches. Its website describes jewellery as a form of personal adornment, including rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets and brooches. It specialises in wedding rings, engagement rings and diamond pieces, and says it contracts only experienced craftsmen to work each piece.

The business says it treats each material with professionalism to bring out its inner beauty. Its website advises buyers to make sure a diamond is certified, and to ask for a certificate from a recognised laboratory such as International Diamond Laboratories. The business operates two branches in Polokwane and a third in Mokopane, Limpopo, and this listing is in Fauna Park.
